earlier_engine_candidate.note: Closed/merged into its feature branch, not evidence that the candidate was merged to canonical main. Its preceding head e108f562... is retained as a separate evidence set.

overall_status_reason: All required rows in the canonical matrix must pass on one exact current candidate SHA. Historical results are scope-specific; PR #53/#58 both have stale bases and do not define current-main acceptance.

immutability_policy.note: The index records the status observed for each exact run/scope. Later candidate results are separate rows; old failures are not rewritten or erased. Current live refs are maintained in current_refs rather than altering historical rows.

verification_method.note: Historical SHAs are those recorded in the dated source reports and cross-checked against commit-bound workflow run listings when available. The GitHub tool response for some runs did not expose every run metadata field. Missing fields are labelled rather than reconstructed.

status_policy.pass_means: That precise job/check scope passed on its own recorded SHA. It does not certify a broader gate or current main.
status_policy.fail_means: That precise applicable check ran and failed; keep its engine and failure scope.
status_policy.blocked_means: A preflight/required prerequisite blocked the oracle; downstream checks did not execute.
status_policy.not_run_means: No qualifying result was established in the inspected evidence.
status_policy.target_engine_rule: MariaDB 11.4 historical PASS/FAIL rows never count as PostgreSQL 17 acceptance.
status_policy.current_main_rule: No historical row is eligible as exact-current-main acceptance unless the tested SHA equals the live reviewed candidate SHA and all required scope/artifact criteria are met.
